reviews.text: Amazingly freindly staff that know what it takes to care for your fur babies

I love that this is a Cat clinic.
I am a cat person, so I appreciate the specialized knowledge and environment.
The staff is friendly and efficient, and the vet is........ patient, and has a great way with cats

I've been taking my two boys here for over 3 years. The staff are excelent! Sarah always follows up with things I need to do for my boys. One of my boys is diabetic (or was he is currently in remission after I had him on insulin 2x/day) and he is mean. The techs have all felt his wrath when simply taking his temp with an ear thermometer, yet they all were so kind and gentle with him while he is stressed. I also like that Larkspur is a cat only clinic. No dogs in the lobby to increase the stress they are already under. I appreciate everyone there and they compassion they have for my boys.
Have been taking my cats here for years and have always had a great experience. They take great care of my Persian when he comes in for grooming. Affordable pricing and friendly staff

this review has been a long time coming - the short version is, i highly recommend larkspur and dr. smith to anyone who is deeply invested in their cat's care and wellbeing.

my husband and i are committed cat people and have always had a multi-cat household. we have primarily seen a different, general practice vet for basic health concerns, but when our most senior cat developed (presumed) nasal/lacrimal duct cancer, i really wanted another opinion and additional advice. it is not an especially common cancer, and due to its location and overall progression, its associated treatments are both invasive/extreme and often have a low success rate.

he had already been to the vet countless times that year - probably 12-15 visits in a 4-month period. we knew we didn't want to pursue "curative" treatment, but were open to palliative care options and weren't receiving much guidance from our usual vet. i was consumed with anxiety and anticipatory grief, and felt very lost as to how to proceed. in hindsight, my deepest desire was to do the "right thing" for our guy, but i felt ambivalent as to what the "right thing" might be.

my husband saw how torn up i was over our cat's illness and suggested seeing a more cat-focused vet - a vet that might have seen similar cases to ours. we both knew of larkspur because of its proximity to the nearby low cost spay & neuter facility, so i made an appointment and took him in.

the front desk queen and office manager, sarah, whom i had communicated with via phone and email, is perfect in that role and immediately put me at ease.

i cannot say enough about dr. smith's expertise. i have read some of the other reviews about his bedside manner, and all i can say is that there will always be different strokes for different folks. i personally knew we were in very good hands instantly. he examined our cat again and asked me a lot of thoughtful and detailed questions. because i am a freak that does a lot of research, i knew what he was getting at with most of his questions - he really tried to sort through all the less devastating alternatives in a relatively short period of time. unfortunately, but not unexpectedly, he came to the same familiar conclusion - it was some type of cancer, and the prognosis was not great.

i say a "relatively short period of time," but when i say that, i am referring only to the exam. dr. smith spent a generous full hour talking things through with me. he patiently explained our options as he saw them, and walked me through the next steps to explore those options if we chose to do so.

he also gave me a much-needed come-to-jesus, which i will distill down to its essence - it is okay - more than okay -  to just take him home, love him, observe him closely, and make that hard decision at the start of his eventual decline. i did not have to continually take him back to the vet. i did not have to put him through any kind of expensive and almost-as-invasive diagnostics to satisfy my personal "need" to know or, at best, potentially open up another option or two with regard to palliative care. perhaps most importantly, he made it clear to me that this was not only "a" choice, it was a kind, loving choice - for myself, and for our cat.

i did not fully appreciate this wisdom until much later. i appreciated his time, his willingness to educate me and share his expertise, etc., but it took some processing time for me to fully recognize the gift he gave me. i also didn't want to accept it as an option at first, but ultimately, it is what we decided to do - and i am forever grateful for it. we had another happy, high-quality-of-life 15 months together (nearly unheard of for cats with this presumed type of cancer), and when he had his first seizure, we knew it was the very first sign of the decline dr. smith mentioned, and we knew it was time to let him go.

we only saw dr. smith once, but he made a huge, significant impact on me. i will always be grateful to him for his patience and compassion, and would recommend him to anyone.
They're always so caring for both the cats and their families. They truly have tender hearts.

From the reviews I see online no do not come I was gonna come hear but I don't wanna risk a sloppy operation and my cat dying rip for any others who was affect by this horrible place, this is a cash grab

We have been going here for about 20 years. Everything from kitten check ups to crossing the rainbow bridge is handled with love and care by the best cat guardian guides.  The whole staff if friendly and understand the subtle balance of cat mentality.

I am extremely disappointed with my experience at this clinic. I brought my sick kitten in with significant respiratory symptoms, congestion, conjunctivitis, a tongue ulcer, and concerning breathing issues. During the appointment, the veterinarian and I discussed starting an antiviral medication. However, when I was checking out, the technician refused to ask the veterinarian about the antiviral we had discussed, leading to an argument at a time when I was already extremely worried about my kitten.

What was most concerning was that my kitten was mouth breathing and acting ill and withdrawn. Rather than leaving reassured, I left feeling that my concerns were being dismissed. As a pet owner, I should not have to argue to have a question relayed to the veterinarian, especially when my kitten’s condition appeared serious enough that I was considering taking her directly to an emergency veterinary hospital from the clinic.

I also found it difficult to communicate with the veterinarian, who often spoke with his eyes closed, making the interaction feel detached and unengaged. When a young kitten is declining, owners need clear communication, responsiveness, and a willingness to promptly re-evaluate when concerns persist. Unfortunately, that was not my experience.

Overall, I left feeling unheard, frustrated, and lacking confidence in the care my kitten received. I cannot recommend this clinic based on my experience.

This clinic is a small, mom and pop type place (which I love), and is obviously run with genuine passion for cats. The facility was very clean, quiet, and shockingly free of cat smell. Since it’s a small place, it did run a tiny bit slowly, but it was a fair trade-off I didn’t mind making for the care my cat was getting.

My cat was a little spicy (no claws, just some hissing and grumbling) with the tech and vet, but both handled it in stride. Dr. Smith clearly loves what he does, and he spent time giving me thoughtful answers to my questions and concerns. The tech Sierra was very sweet and made my first appointment very smooth.

Overall love the choice I made coming here, and will be back!

I had a scare last week. My cat drank some water from a frying pan that I had left on the counter soaking in water and dawn dish soap. She threw up violently andh got extremely ill and didn't eat or drink for 3 days. She received great care here and the routine the vet recommended got her back to normal in a few days. That alone deserves a good review. I don't do many of these reviews but two things pushed me to leave this one:

1) I finally called on Friday morning and even though they close early on Fridays they were able to get me in for an appointment. I thought I was going to have to go to urgent care.

2) My cat does not like going to the vet and she has bit the staff there before and they've had to sedate her but this time they let me try holding her in the exam room while the tech gave her shots and we were able to get them done without the sedation. This was really above and beyond. With everything else I was worried about it was amazing not to have to worry about her being sedated.
Dr. Smith is the best and his staff is so friendly and supportive. We take all of our cat's here!
I have been going here for years and years.  Dr Smith is the best.  Staff is always very helpful.  They have taken care of everything and for a fair price.  I won't go anywhere else.

I had mixed experiences over the years at this clinic, but would give a slight recommendation overall I think. Not the best experiences I’ve had with a vet, and a couple disappointing visits, but also not the worst and the doctor did do a great job on a surgery for my cat.
Best place to take your feline friends, they are patient and take the time needed to get the job done. Best vet experience I’ve ever had!
Only God things to say about this place.

This is a cat clinic. No loud barking. My cat was gently handled. She responded in kind. The nail clipping was $15.
I've been there every year for the past 5: no problems.

Truly caring people!!!!!

I really appreciate these folks .......Awesome!
Great office.
Dr Smith is great and so is the rest of the of the team.
Awful customer service, find someone more accommodating and caring rather than $$$ grabbing. Go to Pet doc of Chandler

We just took our new kitten (Leo) in to see Dr. Smith and honestly couldn’t have had a better experience. He took his time with us, answered every single one of our (probably endless) questions, and never made us feel rushed. You can tell he genuinely loves what he does — he was just as obsessed with our little kitten as we are! He gave us so much helpful information for the weeks ahead and made sure we felt confident as new pet parents. His technician, Ashtin (sorry if I misspelled your name), was also amazing — so gentle and kind with our baby. You can tell they both really care. If you’re looking for a vet who’s knowledgeable, patient, and basically a cat whisperer, Dr. Smith is your person!
Great and wonderful kitty care! So grateful for them...had such a sad situation and they were phenomenal! Thank you all and blessings over you.
Justin and the entire crew are AMAZING! So very happy we found Larkspur Cat Clinic! Or little Noah is in the best care with this office

I have an 11 year old cat that I acquired not long ago, with next to no medical history. I took her in to get her nails trimmed and for a check up. Although I wasn't allowed in because of covid, I really have nothing but great things to say about the experience and the result. My cat had to be sedated (I expected that) and the vet called me with a very calm and reassuring assessment of her health. A couple minor problems were found and addressed and options were given for more preventive treatments, which I opted for out of precaution. Anyway, we are now 2 days home from her day there, and other than a little wobbly reentry from the sedation, she is like a new cat. Comfortable in her own skin, no longer attacking herself and incessantly licking some problematic skin spots. She was a little pouty on day one but today she nose bopped me harder than ever and I know it was her saying thank you. I can't say this place is inexpensive, but as with anything in life, you get what you pay for. Thank you all for your kindness towards Crystal. We will be back, as needed.

Update: these are the most wonderful, skilled, and compassionate people. Any cat would be lucky to be cared for by these angels that walk the earth.
So nice! I love having a cat-only vet. They take plenty of time with my cats during appointments and the vet listens to us about any concerns and takes time to talk through things.

Proud cat dad of 3. I do a lot of research and I’m very strict on who interacts with my cats.

After meeting with Dr. Smith today - I immediately realized this place wasn’t like others in the best way possible.

He took his time. He wasn’t rushed. He explained stuff to me. He let me ask questions and just truly had allotted time in his schedule for my appointment.

Everywhere else they just slam you in and out regardless of the care they provide.

The front staff was amazing. (Thank you Ashton) and everyone there you can tell enjoys their job.

Dr. Smith is extremely knowledgeable and his beliefs on care align with mine perfectly.

I came here after spending 4 years at another cat clinic - I now will have all 3 of my cats under Dr. Smiths care as long as I’m in Phoenix and he’s open.

I highly recommend for the quality of care, the quality of staff and the pricing was 100% fair. At my former cat clinic, I felt as if I was being taken advantage of financially. I am positive that is not happening here and that trust is priceless.

Thank you Larkspur for taking care of Mika’s 3 teeth today. I know she’s difficult to work with and y’all handled it perfectly.

My two fur children needed teeth cleaning and some extractions, they did it same day, which really helped me as I have two cats and there is only one of me.  Dr Smith and Sarah were the best.  They were there for me through the process and answered all my questions in the days after.  They even recommended a medicine for appetite stimulant because my little girl would not eat after the surgery.  I just moved here from California a month ago and am so lucky I the found such a wonderful Vet so soon.

Larkspur was recommended by a cat behaviorist I hired when 2 of my boys began peeing inside my house. The vet and I discussed additional measures at length that I can take to hopefully resolve the issue. The vet and his staff are all extremely helpful, and, patient, and caring, and the clinic is very clean and welcoming. They offer boarding services at reasonable prices. I've been with my previous vet for 15 years, but I've found a better one at Larkspur.
If you have a cat this is the place to go

Nice Dr. and staff. I recently moved to town with a cat that is hard to handle and having urinary issues. We are super thankful ❤️ that they helped her by thinking out of the box and were patient with her.

I had been taking my cats to this clinic for awhile now.  I had brought up the issue that my cat had an issue with diarrhea, and he told it was normal.  After talking with my cousin, who is vet tech, she mentioned that there a product that would help him. I recently took my cat back there, and I mentioned that to the vet. He just now mentioned this to me after I spent a lot of money foolishly because I trusted this vet.

They take very good care of my cats. I love that I am able to drop them off before work and then pick them up after. The staff are all very kind. I would recommend this place for your cats regular cat vet.

I came to this office on the recommendation of an acquaintance and I am so so glad that I did. The whole team is so friendly and kind, even with my aggressive kitty that hates the vet.

I have 5 cats and so far 2 have been seen by Dr. Smith. He has taken such care with both of them and takes time to actually listen and give advice. He is incredibly knowledgeable and has provided insight (that actually works!) that I have never received from other vets. At most vet offices, the Dr is in and out of the room within 5-10 minutes. Dr Smith has taken between 30-60 min during our visits to take a complete medical history, discuss concerns, and give advice/options for next steps.

I cannot recommend this office enough and I know that we will only be bringing our kitties here moving forward. **BONUS** This office is cats only!! No more loud, anxious dogs making an already stressful experience worse for the kitties!

I just had my Pretty Patti kitty groomed/shaved at Larkspur and they did a great job. My cat is beautiful and happy. I couldn't be happier with their service, care for my cat, and price was not bad either. Highly recommend.
Great staff and doc

I have been in the veterinary field for about 20 years. I worked at a low cost spay and neuter clinic so for all of my full service needs for my cats. I only see Dr. Smith at Larkspur Cat Clinic . And the office manager, Sarah, is also so amazing.
I absolutely recommend this clinic, for any cat owner, for any full service need.

What an amazing experience from start to finish and I am so grateful that I discovered Larkspur Cat Clinic!! My beloved cat Smokey had an emergency situation and everyone told me based on the pictures I shared overnight, that they thought it was a prolapsed rectum. I was ready to go to the emergency animal hospital early this morning, as an urgent case, until a friend recommended that I call Larkspur Cat Clinic.
I was completely torn on what to do, so I called them this morning and the wonderful woman I spoke to said “can you be here by 9:30”?!!! They were going to check him in and call me once they were able to look at him as a walk in. That actually worked out perfect for me because I was able to drive right to work, after I dropped him off. I didn’t have to lose a day at work, or sit at the vets for hours, more stressed out than even Smokey was!
Well, I was impressed from the moment I arrived…what a lovely clinic they have and how professional and kind they were! They brought Smokey right back and off to work I went, covered in cat fur! Trying to work and stay focused was difficult while waiting for an update. I received a call right after 1:00 pm from Dr. Smith. I was bracing myself all morning for bad news but in the most calm and reassuring demeanor, he informed me that Smokey was going to be absolutely fine and it was a horribly inflamed anal gland. Let me tell you my relief as I have been to other places over the years (both cats and dogs), where they suggest to do tons of lab work, ultrasound,  x-ray’s and such and that’s OK when it’s necessary, but he knew exactly what needed to be done, and I was so pleasantly surprised by the cost and the level of care and expertise! THEY KNOW CATS!! But most of all impressed on how reassuring Dr. Smith was when explaining the situation to me and the aftercare. Had I went to the emergency animal hospital, I am sure I would’ve paid three times as much! I just picked Smokey up and brought him home and he is resting so comfortably now. Thank you Dr Smith and Larkspur Cat Clinic and I am so grateful that I found you today! Hats off to your amazing clinic and you definitely set the bar high…Smokey agrees!

I really liked this clinic for a little while but unfortunately my oldest cat passed away this summer, and the clinic handled it strangely. I took her in to the clinic two weeks prior to her passing and the vet didn’t offer to pull blood work despite my concerns. She died a few weeks later, and when I called the clinic, the staff was cold over the phone. My other cat got sick a month later, and when I called them to make an appointment and begged to get in, they told me that I’d have to go to an emergency vet (which is fair) and made it difficult to access her records (which is not). I don’t go anymore because of the weird cold attitude during my older cat’s passing and the denial of care for my other cat.

They were great when I saw them for routine visits, but they’re not equipped emotionally or physically to take care of any large issues.
We have always had positive experiences with this clinic. The people are very kind, and the only problem is that we moved and they are quite a ways away from us now.
Great veteran for cats, friendly and knowledgeable . Cover all areas/options for medical care and treatments available for your cat and how to proceed with that care.
The best place to take your best kitty friend.
Staff is very friendly and works so well with my sassy cat
We’ve taken our cats here for over a decade and will continue to do so! Dr. Smith is a cat whisperer, and Sarah and the rest of the staff are all so knowledgeable and kind.
Very knowledgeable my cat has been seeing the doctor here since I got her, so 3 years now. I have taken multiple kitties here.
Super friendly staff. Have taken multiple cats here for years. They make my cats feel safe and special

The entire staff was all around pleasant and very gentle with my fur baby Shug who was very ill. I didn't have an appointment and was still seen within 5 minutes of being there. They treated Shug and made sure I had everything I needed with good directions on how and when to administer. The whole visit maybe took 25 mins and my Shug left feeling 100× better than he had in days. And the price was very doable and budget friendly. I will definitely be bringing my fur babies here for all the medical needs. Thank you Larkspur Cat Clinic for everything ❤️
